query: Is the beneficiary farmer subsidy for Mukhyamantri Saur Krushi Pump 100% free for all general category farmers?
corpus_position: Official GR specifies 90% subsidy for SC/ST and 95% or 90% for small/marginal farmers with a mandatory 5-10% beneficiary contribution; not 100% free for general category.
web_position: Certain informal news blogs and social media claim the scheme provides 100% free solar pumps to all farmers unconditionally.
expected_behavior: Must prioritize official GR contribution rules and explicitly note web claims of 100% free pumps are inaccurate/unverified.

query: Has the UDCPR building height limit in residential zones across Maharashtra been raised to 100 meters without high-rise committee approval?
corpus_position: UDCPR requires specific road-width ratios, fire safety clearance, and Special High-Rise Committee approval for structures exceeding specified heights.
web_position: Real estate promotional blogs suggest all height caps have been removed uniformly under new notifications.
expected_behavior: Must uphold official UDCPR regulatory mandates regarding road width and High-Rise Committee clearances.

query: What is the maximum financial aid granted under Majhi Kanya Bhagyashree scheme on the birth of a second girl child?
corpus_position: Official GR prescribes Rs. 25,000 for each of the two girl children in a family after family planning operation.
web_position: Multiple third-party aggregator portals report Rs. 50,000 or Rs. 1,00,000 lump sum amounts erroneously.
expected_behavior: Must cite official GR payout structure while clarifying discrepancy with third-party web portals.

query: Is there an exemption from paying stamp duty on agricultural land purchase for women farmers across Maharashtra?
corpus_position: Revenue Department GR grants a 1% concession in stamp duty for female buyers in specific categories, but not a total 100% exemption across all transactions.
web_position: Viral news snippets often proclaim 0% stamp duty for women purchasers unconditionally.
expected_behavior: Must detail exact 1% concession guidelines per Revenue GR and refute total exemption rumors.

query: What is the maximum area entitlement for constructing a farm pond under Magel Tyala Shettale without prior technical survey?
corpus_position: Agriculture GR requires technical feasibility, geo-tagging, and limits sizes (e.g. 30x30x3 meters) based on land holding size.
web_position: Informal agriculture forums claim farmers can build any dimension pond anywhere on their land without prior survey.
expected_behavior: Must affirm technical verification requirement stated in corpus GR.

query: What is the annual income limit for the Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Jan Arogya Yojana health insurance coverage?
corpus_position: Government Resolution expanded coverage to all ration card holders (yellow/orange/white) with specified sum assured of Rs. 5 Lakhs per family per year.
web_position: Older web articles still cite outdated Rs. 1 Lakh income cap and old Rs. 1.5 Lakh sum insured limit.
expected_behavior: Must cite latest GR entitlement of Rs. 5 Lakh and note historical/outdated web figures.

query: Can Transferable Development Rights (TDR) be generated from non-congested agricultural zones in D-class municipal corporations?
corpus_position: UDCPR rules strictly regulate TDR origin zones to designated reservation plots, road widening, and heritage sites, not arbitrary non-congested agri zones.
web_position: Real estate broker forums suggest unrestricted TDR generation across all outlying zones.
expected_behavior: Must cite UDCPR Chapter 11 TDR regulations as authoritative.

query: Are farmers required to pay any application fee on the MahaDBT portal for tractor subsidy applications?
corpus_position: Corpus GR specifies a nominal non-refundable lottery processing fee (Rs. 20 + GST) on MahaDBT portal.
web_position: Some web guides claim the application is entirely free of all portal processing fees.
expected_behavior: Must verify exact MahaDBT fee structure according to Agriculture Department circulars.

query: What is the compensation rate per hectare for monsoon flood crop loss declared under the 2023 disaster relief GR?
corpus_position: Relief and Rehabilitation GR specifies exact SDRF/NDRF norm revisions (e.g. Rs. 13,600/ha for rainfed, Rs. 27,000/ha for irrigated up to 3 hectares).
web_position: Political rally speeches reported online cite promise of Rs. 50,000/ha flat compensation.
expected_behavior: Must cite official disaster relief GR rates as binding over unverified speech promises.

query: Is rooftop solar installation mandatory for all existing independent houses in municipal council areas under UDCPR?
corpus_position: UDCPR mandates solar water heating/rooftop solar only for plots/buildings above specified built-up area thresholds (e.g. >100 sq.m or multi-dwelling), not small existing independent houses.
web_position: Eco-blog posts claim 100% of residential structures in Maharashtra face disconnection if rooftop solar is missing.
expected_behavior: Must cite UDCPR threshold provisions and clarify false web alarm.

query: What is the maximum age limit for applying to the Babasaheb Ambedkar Swadhar Yojana for higher education?
corpus_position: Social Justice GR specifies age limits aligned with university admission criteria and category relaxations (typically up to 28/30 years).
web_position: Web exam portals often copy age limits from central civil service exams (35-40 years) incorrectly.
expected_behavior: Must adhere to Social Justice Department scheme parameters.

query: Does the Maharashtra Tree Authority allow felling of heritage trees (over 50 years) with only compensatory plantation of 1 sapling?
corpus_position: Maharashtra (Urban Areas) Protection and Preservation of Trees Amendment Act mandates compensatory planting equal to the age of the felled heritage tree.
web_position: General tree cutting guides claim 1:1 or 1:3 ratio applies uniformly to all trees.
expected_behavior: Must cite the Heritage Tree Protection legislation requiring saplings equal to tree age.
